caption:
Swipe to see what happened when Mario Lopez posted an AI video of his own niece 👀

Mario Lopez used AI to generate a video featuring his niece and posted it publicly, the post exploded to 2.2 million views and 42,000 likes, thousands flooded his replies calling it the creepiest celebrity moment of the year, one reply saying he should never see her again got 69,000 likes and 14,000 reposts.
